purpose: Multi-trial Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR haircut input

factor_universe.method: PIT-rolling top-80 by coverage at each sig_date

rationale_for_n_trials: Per Lopez de Prado 2020 ML for Asset Managers Ch 8: n_trials = distinct DSR-eligible specs. Factor preselect via PIT-rolling top-80 is data-driven not hyperparameter search → does not multiply n_trials in same way grid search does. Internal CV (Ridge 13α, EN 20α) = bona fide multi-trial. Primary n_trials = 7 (model specs) + 33 (CV grid) = 40 (single-step view) or 7 (multi-step view). Both reported in DSR computation.
